title: John McQueeney shares campaign activities and education support in latest social media posts
text:
← Back to the wire
John McQueeney shares campaign activities and education support in latest social media posts
John McQueeney, state representative for Texas’s District 97 since 2025, posted updates about recent campaign activities and educational endorsements on September 30 and October 1, 2026.
John McQueeney, a Republican elected to the Texas State House in 2025 to represent the state's 97th House district, shared updates on his campaign activities and support for education through several posts on his social media account.
On September 30, 2026, McQueeney recapped a busy day of campaigning: "Had a day full of meetings, but still found a little time to squeeze in some door knocking! Special thanks to my wife Katie — apparently “for better or worse” also includes being the campaign driver. Another good day covering ground across #HD97!"
The following day, October 1, 2026, he highlighted his endorsement from an educational organization: "A great education opens doors for a lifetime! I’m honored to have Charter Schools Now's support and proud to stand with Texas educators, parents, and schools working every day to help our kids succeed. Strong schools and strong students mean a stronger Texas! #txed #txlege"
Later that same day, McQueeney posted about recent weather benefiting his campaign efforts: "Our prayers for rain have been answered! Some much-needed rain made for perfect timing for a little sign duty. And yes, I put out my own signs! #McQueeneyOnTheMove"
McQueeney succeeded Craig Goldman as representative of District 97 after winning election in 2025.
